QuestInfo.name: New Beginnings
QuestInfo.0: Feng looks like he had something to say. Talk to him.
QuestInfo.1:
You decided to chase after Yun Wu and the syndicate members to Victoria Island.
Feng said he will accompany you.
Head to the docks after saying good bye to Xiao Xiao and the others.
QuestInfo.2:
You said your farewells to your fellow pupils.
Xiao Xiao told you to come back if you ever feel weary, fatigued, hungry, or whatever else.

default.0: You should talk to all your folks. I'll be waiting for ya.
